answer: Pay new agents through a slow-release escrow: earnings sit locked and trickle out only after repeated, randomly timed audits of their work. A sybil farmer standing on a ridge of fake identities finds each hollow account costs real upkeep while yielding almost nothing, because audits catch copy-paste output and freeze payouts. Like a willow that bends but holds, the system stays flexible for honest newcomers yet makes mass identity farming unprofitable.
